2 person scenario.rules: players ask the audience for a word. when given the word, they then proceed to act out a scene until the timer expires

3 person scenario.rules: players ask the audience for a word. when given the word, they then proceed to act out a scene until the timer expires

tagouts.rules: tag people out when you want to enter a scene

numbers game.rules: the audience assigns a number to each of the 3 players. each player can only speak in sentences that have the same number of words as the number they were assigned. then the audience suggests a word, and players act out a scene until time is up
